item.text: {"text":"{\"status\":\"NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT\",\"core_findings\":[\"Electronics has the weakest sampled positive–negative separation: 14.95% of negatives outrank positives, 21.15% of margins fall below 0.5, and the 10th-percentile margin is −0.4812. Movies_and_TV has the strongest separation, with only 3.03% wrong ranks and a 10th-percentile margin of 2.1793.\",\"Industrial_and_Scientific and CDs_and_Vinyl show intermediate separation, with wrong-rank rates of 8.22% and 9.14%. Embedding similarity scores of 0.5392–0.5566 indicate modest average directional alignment, without evidence of severe collapse.\"],\"key_implications\":[\"Sampled ranking errors are most prevalent in Electronics despite a positive mean margin of 2.2712.\",\"Representation alignment is similar across datasets, while ranking separation varies substantially; these measurements do not establish alignment as the cause of ranking errors.\",\"These diagnostic margins do not establish validation HR@10, and empty category breakdowns provide no basis for attributing errors to item categories.\"],\"evidence\":{\"headline_metrics\":{\"Electronics:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.1495,\"Electronics:pos_neg_margin_p10\":-0.4812,\"Electronics:pos_neg_small_margin_rate\":0.2115,\"Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.0303},\"brief_metric_read\":{\"Electronics:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":\"Highest fraction of sampled negatives scoring above positives.\",\"Electronics:pos_neg_margin_p10\":\"Lower-tail margins are negative.\",\"Electronics:pos_neg_small_margin_rate\":\"21.15% of margins are below 0.5.\",\"Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":\"Lowest sampled wrong-rank rate.\"}}}"}
